title: Potential EtherHiding C2 via Curl JSON-RPC Request
author: Elastic
description:
Detects when curl or nscurl is spawned by a shell or osascript to make a JSON-RPC request to a blockchain
endpoint for command and control purposes. Adversaries may leverage blockchain smart contracts as a covert
C2 channel to retrieve commands or payload staging information, as observed in ClickFix campaigns.
